title: Design Fault-Tolerant Consensus Partition Recovery
overview: In a 5-node cluster, a transient asymmetric network partition isolates nodes 3 and 4 while 18 state transitions occur on leader node 1. Design the log reconciliation protocol.
deliverables: Interactive architecture diagram with heartbeat & quorum boundaries
Production Go implementation of Term Election & Log Rollback handlers
Documented verification proof of zero-loss state transitions

title: Dynamic Raft Heartbeat Tuning Under Jitter
overview: Implement adaptive randomized election timeouts that adjust in real-time to synthetic ping variance between 10ms and 450ms without causing split-brain quorum cascades.

title: L2 Order Book Microstructure Queue Model
overview: Model priority queuing under non-Poisson order arrival rates across fragmented matching engines. Prove order execution latency bounds.
